proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6559.3 *dehila explicitly gives Nepali dailo door/threshold. Majhi and Bote dailo select this branch rather than the dehalī or dehula branches. Exact survey form dailo is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7 aṃsiya explicitly gives Nepali hã̄siyo, Bengali/Hindi hã̄siyā and Bihari hãsuā sickle, as well as Kumaoni ã̄sī scythe. The selected forms preserve these y-bearing, u-bearing and h-less variants; uncertain regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form hãsiya is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2817 karkaṭa explicitly gives Nepali kā̃kro and related kā̃kri cucumber. These kãkro/kãkra forms fit that named plant family; the article qualifies its deeper relation to karkaṭa crab and karkāru. Exact survey form kãkra is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
